title: Venue dislocation
description: How far Kalshi and Polymarket disagree on the odds of Up, after adjusting for their different strikes. A dislocation means one venue has moved and the other has not yet.

state.label: Dislocation state
state.description: Aligned when the two venues agree within a threshold, dislocated when they do not. Dislocations tend to close from the lagging side.

direction.label: Dislocation direction
direction.description: Which venue is pricing Up higher. That venue is either ahead of the move or overpaying.

dislocation_bps.label: Venue gap
dislocation_bps.description: The strike-adjusted gap between the two venues' odds of Up, in basis points. Bigger means a wider disagreement.

implied_up_kalshi.label: Kalshi odds of Up
implied_up_kalshi.description: The odds of Up implied by Kalshi's midpoint, as a percentage. Read against its own strike.

implied_up_polymarket.label: Polymarket odds of Up
implied_up_polymarket.description: The odds of Up implied by Polymarket's midpoint, as a percentage. Read against its own strike.
